faqs.question: Minimum order kitna hai?
faqs.answer: Ji, minimum 10 pieces se order kar sakte hain ready stock items ke liye. Custom orders ke liye MOQ vary karta hai.

faqs.question: GSM kya hota hai?
faqs.answer: GSM matlab Grams per Square Meter — fabric ki thickness batata hai. 180 GSM light hota hai everyday ke liye, 200 GSM premium printing ke liye best, 220 GSM heavy premium hai.

faqs.question: Bio-washed kya hota hai?
faqs.answer: Bio-washed matlab enzyme treatment hota hai — fabric ko extra soft aur smooth banata hai. Washing ke baad bhi quality same rehti hai.

faqs.question: Combed cotton kya hai?
faqs.answer: Combed cotton mein shorter fibers nikal diye jaate hain, sirf premium long fibers rehte hain. Isse fabric zyada soft, smooth aur durable hoti hai.

faqs.question: Delivery time kya hai?
faqs.answer: Delhi NCR mein 1-2 din, North India 2-4 din, South India 3-5 din. Ready stock items 24-48 ghante mein dispatch. Priority dispatch bhi available hai.

faqs.question: COD available hai?
faqs.answer: Ji, first order pe 50% COD available hai (+3% COD charge). Second order onwards prepaid hota hai. Online payment pe Rs 3/piece discount milta hai.

faqs.question: Custom printing karte ho?
faqs.answer: Hum blank/plain t-shirts banate hain — printing businesses ke liye. Aap apna printing khud kar sakte ho (DTG, DTF, Screen Print). Humari t-shirts printing ke liye optimized hain.

faqs.question: Export karte ho?
faqs.answer: Ji bilkul, hum export karte hain courier aur sea transport dono se. Many countries mein supply karte hain. Quantity bata do, rates share kar denge.

faqs.question: GST invoice milega?
faqs.answer: Ji sir, har order ke saath GST invoice provide karte hain. Hum registered manufacturer hain.

faqs.question: Oversized available hai?
faqs.answer: Ji, oversized t-shirts available hain. 200 GSM Rs 130 se aur 220 GSM Rs 145 se. Drop shoulder, boxy fit — trending style. Ready stock hai.

faqs.question: Hoodie ka rate kya hai?
faqs.answer: Plain hoodie 320 GSM Rs 310 se, heavy 430 GSM Rs 410 se. 100% cotton fleece, bio-washed. Kangaroo pocket, adjustable hood. Ready stock.

faqs.question: Sweatshirt available hai?
faqs.answer: Ji, plain sweatshirt 320 GSM Rs 280 se start. Crew neck, no hood, clean look. 100% cotton fleece. Winter ke liye perfect.

faqs.question: Polo t-shirt hai?
faqs.answer: Ji sir, polo t-shirt 220 GSM Rs 150 se. 100% cotton pique fabric. Corporate wear aur casual dono ke liye perfect.

faqs.question: Acid wash available hai?
faqs.answer: Haan ji, acid wash t-shirts available hain — regular fit Rs 155 se aur oversized Rs 175 se. Vintage look, trending hai. MOQ 25 pieces.

faqs.question: Bulk discount milega?
faqs.answer: Bilkul! 500+ pieces pe Rs 2/piece discount. Online purchase pe Rs 3/piece discount (koi bhi quantity). 1000+ ke liye special rates — WhatsApp pe baat karo.

faqs.question: Sample order kaise karu?
faqs.answer: 5-10 pieces order karo as sample, same factory rate pe milega. First order pe COD bhi available hai. sale91.com pe order karo ya WhatsApp pe baat karo.

faqs.question: Factory kahan hai?
faqs.answer: Humari factory Tiruppur, Tamil Nadu mein hai — India ka textile hub. Delhi mein warehouse hai Khanpur, South Delhi mein. Factory se direct supply, koi middleman nahi.

faqs.question: Return policy kya hai?
faqs.answer: Agar koi defect ya quality issue ho toh replacement available hai. Delivery ke 48 ghante mein report karo with photos. Humara quality check strict hai, rarely issues aate hain.

faqs.question: White t-shirt ka rate?
faqs.answer: White round neck 180 GSM Rs 89, 200 GSM Rs 99, 220 GSM Rs 115. Oversized 200 GSM Rs 130. Sab bio-washed, combed cotton. Ready stock hai.

faqs.question: Black t-shirt ka rate?
faqs.answer: Black round neck 180 GSM Rs 95, 200 GSM Rs 110, 220 GSM Rs 125. Oversized 200 GSM Rs 140. Color items slightly zyada hota hai. Ready stock.
